notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Deathbloom Ritualist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.
